CREATE TRIGGER trg_vincular_ajudante BEFORE INSERT ON public.ajudantes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION vincular_ajudante()
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION vincular_usuario()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_itens_desejo_atualizado BEFORE UPDATE ON public.itens_desejo FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_atualizado_em()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.estado_jogo()
 RETURNS TABLE(rodada_id uuid, ordem integer, status status_rodada, revelador_id uuid, revelador_nome text, amigo_id uuid, amigo_nome text, total_votos bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select r.id, r.ordem, r.status, s.quem_da_id, pd.nome,
         case when r.status = 'revelada' then s.quem_recebe_id end,
         case when r.status = 'revelada' then pr.nome end,
         (select count(*) from palpites pa where pa.rodada_id = r.id)
    from rodadas r
    join sorteio s       on s.id  = r.sorteio_id
    join participantes pd on pd.id = s.quem_da_id
    join participantes pr on pr.id = s.quem_recebe_id
   order by r.ordem
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jogo_encerrar_votacao()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not sou_admin() then raise exception 'Apenas admin'; end if;
  update rodadas set status = 'encerrada'
   where id = (select id from rodadas order by ordem desc limit 1)
     and status = 'votando';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.meu_participante_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id from participantes where auth_user_id = auth.uid()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.minhas_conversas()
 RETURNS TABLE(sorteio_id uuid, meu_papel autor_mensagem)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id, 'da'::autor_mensagem from sorteio
   where quem_da_id = meu_participante_id()
      or quem_da_id in (select participantes_que_ajudo())
  union all
  select id, 'recebe'::autor_mensagem from sorteio
   where quem_recebe_id = meu_participante_id()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.participantes_que_ajudo()
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select participante_id from ajudantes where auth_user_id = auth.uid()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ranking()
 RETURNS TABLE(participante_id uuid, nome text, acertos bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.id, p.nome, count(pa.id) filter (where pa.acertou)
    from participantes p
    left join palpites pa on pa.votante_id = p.id
   group by p.id, p.nome
   order by 3 desc, p.nome
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_atualizado_em()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  new.atualizado_em := now();
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sou_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select is_admin from participantes where auth_user_id = auth.uid()), false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vincular_ajudante()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
begin
  new.email := lower(new.email);
  select id into new.auth_user_id from auth.users where lower(email) = new.email;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vincular_usuario()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update participantes set auth_user_id = new.id where email = lower(new.email);
  update ajudantes     set auth_user_id = new.id where email = lower(new.email);
  return new;
end $function$
